# Ricardo Morales

> Senior backend engineer in Mexico City. Twelve years building and modernizing Java and Spring Boot microservices for banking, payments, insurance, and media clients, including BBVA, Santander, HSBC, Banorte, Expedia, and Disney.

## Core stack

Java, Spring Boot, Quarkus, Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, GitHub Actions, Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, Redis, Angular, TypeScript, LLM integration.

## Selected work

- [QuizzerA: AI Interview System](https://drupalio.dev/projects/quizzer-ai-interview-system): LLM interview assistant, feedback cycle from 5 days to under 48 hours.
- [Banking Platform Modernization](https://drupalio.dev/projects/banking-modernization): monolith to Spring Boot microservices for Banco Nacional del Perú.
- [Financial Microservices on Kubernetes](https://drupalio.dev/projects/financial-microservices-k8s): Quarkus native microservices on Google Cloud.
- [Batch Payment Infrastructure](https://drupalio.dev/projects/batch-payment-infrastructure): nightly invoicing and cinema payments for Disney.
- [Digital Banking Expansion](https://drupalio.dev/projects/hsbc-digital-banking): microservices and feature flags for HSBC.
